visual_action: The video is a 'before and after' style edit. The first half shows Donald Trump walking slowly at night, looking somber while holding a red hat. The second half is a montage of clips showing Donald Trump dancing energetically on stage at rallies in front of large crowds, appearing happy and celebratory.

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: Donald Trump is shown in every clip of the video, and his name is featured prominently in the on-screen text.

on_screen_text.text: Trump before he killed Roe v. Wade 😔
Trump after he stripped reproductive rights away from millions of women 🥰

spoken_summary: There is no speech in the video; the audio consists entirely of two different music tracks.
audio_music: The video begins with the dramatic, angsty rock song 'Bring Me To Life' by Evanescence. About 5 seconds in, the music abruptly switches to the upbeat, cheerful pop song 'Unwritten' by Natasha Bedingfield. The shift from a dark, serious track to a bright, happy one creates a strong, ironic contrast between the two sections of the video.
editing_pacing: The video starts with a single, slow-motion shot, then transitions into a montage of several short clips with quick cuts.
cultural_references: The song 'Bring Me To Life' by Evanescence, which is also a popular internet meme.
central_claim: Donald Trump callously celebrated his role in overturning Roe v. Wade, which stripped reproductive rights from millions of women.
intended_effect: To generate outrage and negative sentiment towards Donald Trump by portraying him as gleeful about the removal of abortion rights.
